1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Ahli Parlimen
(Saraan) (Pindaan Jadual Pertama) 1990.

2. Perenggan 2 Jadual Pertama kepada Akta Ahli Parlimen (Saraan)
1980 adalah dipinda—

(a)

(b)

dengan menggantikan noktah di hujung subperenggan (1)
dengan noktah bertindih dan memasukkan selepas itu,
proviso yang berikut:

"Dengan syarat bahawa jika seseorang yang menjadi
Ahli atau Anggota untuk pertama kalinya pada atau selepas
1hb Julai 1990 berhenti menjadi Ahli atau Anggota apabila
menyempurnakan tiga puluh enam bulan perkhidmatan
yang boleh dimasukira tetapi masih belum mencapai umur
lima puluh tahun pada tarikh dia berhenti menjadi Ahli atau
Anggota, dia boleh diberi pencen hanya apabila dia
kemudiannya mencapai umur lima puluh tahun."; dan

dengan memasukkan selepas subperenggan (2),
subperenggan baru (24) yang berikut:

"(2a) Dalam hal seseorang yang menjadi Ahli atau
Anggota untuk pertama kalinya pada atau selepas 1hb Julai

MEMBERS OF PARLIAMENT (REMUNERATION) ACT 1980

MEMBERS OF PARLIAMENT (REMUNERATION) (AMENDMENT OF FIRST
SCHEDULE) ORDER 1990

In exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 19a of the First
Act 237.             Schedule to the Members of Parliament (Remuneration) Act 1980, the
Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the following order:

Citation.         1. This Order may be cited as the Members of Parliament

(Remuneration) (Amendment of First Schedule) Order 1990.
Srreiment       2. Paragraph 2 of the First Schedule to the Members of Parliament
eae        (Remuneration) Act 1980 is amended—

(a) by substituting for the full stop at the end of subparagraph
(1) a colon and inserting thereafter the following proviso:

"Provided that where a person who becomes a Member
for the first time on or after the 1st July 1990 ceases to be a
Member upon completing thirty six months of reckonable
service but has not attained the age of fifty years on the date
he ceases to be a Member, he may be granted a pension only
upon his thereafter attaining the age of fifty years."; and

(b

~~

by inserting after subparagraph (2) the following new
subparagraph (2a):

"(2a) Inthe case of a person who becomes a Member for
the first time on or after the 1st July 1990 but has not
attained the age of fifty years on the date he ceases to be a
Member, the salary on which a pension will be granted
under subparagraph (2) shall be the last revised salary
before the pension is granted to him.".

Made the 11th June 1990.
[JPA/PEN. (Rahsia) 228/26/6-1; PN. (PU*) 369 Pt. II.]

By Command,

Dato' Seri AHMAD Sari BIN ABDUL HAMID,
Secretary to the Cabinet
